1.title: AI Dramas Are Already a $14 Billion Market | Ruby Justice Thelot
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Breakdown of the $14B vertical drama market (ReelShort, Douyin), K-pop contract mechanics, and how AI-generated content is reshaping digital culture and gamblification patterns.

2.title: Frontier AI Models Are Shockingly Gullible | Snehal Antani
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Snehal Antani (Horizon3.ai CEO) on why frontier AI models fail against basic cyber deception, the moat of private training data over compute, and how attackers exploit machine-speed execution of known flaws rather than zero-days.

1.title: Anthropic Beats OpenAI 2-to-1 With New Teams | Harpreet Arora
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Harpreet Arora (Vercel AI Product Lead) shares enterprise adoption data from Vercel's AI Gateway: Anthropic gaining 2-to-1 adoption over OpenAI, slowdown in open-weight model improvements, voice workflows seeing rapid team adoption, video models reliability outlook.

1.title: Closed Frontier Labs Are Pulling Ahead of Open AI | Melvin Johnson
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Melvin Johnson (Google DeepMind) on Gemini 4 model family (Argon, Carbon, Hydrogen), Google's vertical integration advantages (TPUs, distribution) vs open-weight models, and where agentic consumer products like Search AI Mode are headed.

1.title: Why Canva’s Craft Model Beats Frontier Labs at Design | Stefano Corazza
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Stefano Corazza (Canva Head of AI Research) on how Canva trains models to learn design taste and layout planning from 250M monthly users' real-time edits as RL signals, why this approach beats frontier labs at creative work, and predictions on 100x video generation cost drops.

2.title: Silicon Valley Is Building Against Human Meaning | Nathan Sharp
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Former Instagram Stories PM Nathan Sharp argues that AI generation will make real human photos scarce and valuable, and that platforms mistakenly optimize away manual effort (sharing friction, weekly cadence) that actually creates social meaning—uses Retro (his weekly journal product) as a case study in designing against AGI replication.
